title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E3 — Richard Pryor, Ralph Edwards, Bobby Sandler
Richard Pryor does stand-up and joins Flip for sketches including This Is Your Life Geraldine Jones hosted by Ralph Edwards.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E6 — Robert Goulet, Carol Lawrence, Slappy White
Flip jokes about karate; Slappy White does stand-up and a soft shoe dance joining the whole cast for a burlesque segment.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E7 — Henry 'Hank' Aaron, Lee Grant, Gladys Knight, Andrew Johnson
Lee shoots a commercial; baseball great Hank Aaron does Q&A then is the subject of a testimonial dinner sketch with the full cast.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E9 — Ed McMahon, Charlie Callas, Leonard Nimoy
Callas does a physical comedy routine; McMahon is a huckster and Flip & Nimoy are in the environmentalist Mafia.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E8 — Jerry Butler
Singer Jerry Butler headlines this episode, together with his back-up group, Peaches.  Highlights of their numbers are "Make It Easy on Yourself" and "Brand New Me".

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E9 — Morgan/Silver/Humphrey
An all jazz line-up on this edition of Soul! features pianist Horace Silver at the electric keyboard, Lee Morgan on trumpet and 22-year old Bobbi Humphrey playing the flute. They are joined by vocalists Andy and Salome Bey.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E10 — A Question of Honor
All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E12 — Educating Katherine
Katherine gets a taste of the worst: being a volunteer art teacher. She feels that she is boring and failing, so Webster tries to help her.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E13 — Teddy Bear Scare
George and Katherine both try and persuade Webster that he can do without his teddy bear, which is lost.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E14 — George, The Patient in Spite of Himself
Webster has to have his tonsils out, so he tries to be tough just like George.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E17 — Paper or Plastic?
Tamera crosses the picket lines to work at a supermarket, but soon realizes that being a "scab" isn't all it's cracked up to be.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E18 — The Piano Lesson
Ray learns a "noteworthy" lesson in honesty when he "fibs" and tells a tone-deaf Tamera that she plays the piano well, and she winds up humiliating herself at a piano recital.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E19 — Summer Bummer
Tia and Tamera trade places so that Tia can be with a cute guy in summer school and Tamera can "goof off" by taking Tia's spot as a camp counselor.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E20 — The Candidate
Tamera learns how much she needs Tia's help when she runs for class president.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E21 — Big Twin on Campus
When Tia poses as a college student to impress her older boyfriend, Tamera goes to great lengths to fit in with Tia's new circle of "mature" friends.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E19 — Something About Moesha
Having been neighbors and friends nearly all their lives, Moesha and Hakeem wonder if there is more to their relationship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E20 — The Robbing Hood
Moesha and Hakeem explore their evolving dating relationship.  Dorian visits Moesha on campus and Moesha sees this as a chance to forge a sister/brother relationship; items begin missing from dorm rooms and all clues lead towards Dorian.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E21 — Arriving Right On Q
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship hits a snag when Q returns to town; sparks fly between Moesha and Q;  Q invites Moesha to spend the summer (as a road manager) on tour with his rap group.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E22 — D-Money Loses His Patience
Hakeem tries to convince Moesha to pass on Q’s offer to go on the road with his band, and focus on her priorities: school, family, and him.  Moesha admits to being too distracted to make a clear decision.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E1 — On The Rebound
Moesha and Q decide whether or not to take their relationship to the next level; Dorian returns home from boot camp.

S2 E13 — Check Snub
When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.

S2 E14 — Author, Author
Sandra writes a steamy romance novel based on characters that are suspiciously similar to her friends at 227.

S2 E15 — The Working Game
Mary's new job with a travel agency takes her out-of-town on business with her boss, leaving a jealous Lester at home. Special guest appearance by Garrett Morris.

S2 E16 — Rich Kid
Mary takes a stand against the deadly drug, crack when she discovers that a wealthy and generous new friend of Calvin and Brenda is selling the drug.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E16 — Jugglin'
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E17 — Everynight Fever
Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E18 — The Commercial
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E19 — Whole Lotta Love Seat
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.
